steps.message: Press G to place a grid surface helper at the cursor near the center of the scene.
draw a close line on one of the vertical planes, press Esc to finish
pres Esc until all the helpers are gone then use a right-to-left selection window select all the created line segments.
Sketch a closed swipe trajectory on the ground (use 4 quarter circle arcs to sketch afull circle), press Enter when finished
the rotational swipe is create, Use a right-to-left selection window to select half of the shape, .
the rotational swipe is created, Position the camera on top view and select the half of the created shape that has a holeUse a right-to-left selection window to select.
Click the Delete button to delete the selected items
Use a right-to-left selection window to select the remaining half.
Press T to place an axis helper at the cursor.
Use the helper to chose the vertical/blue rotation axis, rotate a copy ( toggle copy mode by briefly pressing ctrl ) by 180 degrees
